posts.title: Goodbye, Stan
posts.description: On Saturday, November 14, 2026, we had to say goodbye to our dear little man, Stan. He was 18-1/2 years old, which is a good long life for a cat. We brought Stan and his brother, Kai, home in July 2008 as kittens, brothers from the same litter. Kai was always a little bigger than Stan, but Stan ran the show and we all knew it. posts.title: QR Code Coaster Generator
posts.description: I built a little in-browser app that can create a customizable, full-color 3D model of a coaster with a QR code on it, ready for printing. Go check it out! There are a ton of these apps out there - apps that create QR codes and let you export them or put them on a 3D printable coaster, but I found there were problems with all of these: They’re not free.
